verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed deployment, including on-prem or private/public cloud, a Docker start-local quickstart, and an official Kubernetes operator that users praise; a licensing comment confirms self-hosting remains permitted. Parity with the hosted product is not shown: serverless-only capabilities include autoscaling, separated search/index tiers and cross-project search. Community reports also say key features such as security, ML and fine-grained access control sit behind paid subscriptions when self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-managed and serverless, self-hosted equivalents of autoscaling, tier separation and cross-project search, and core features like security available without paid tiers.
